rationale.reason: Stationary mineral jaw crushers/dry screens fit 8474.10/.20; other mixing/forming machinery and mobile service outputs are outside the accepted subset.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

Complete stationary electrically driven jaw crushers and dry vibrating mineral screens manufactured for delivery in one declared configuration. This narrower category does not cover every activity in CPC44440. Keep crusher and screen families, frame connection, fitted drive, screen media/wear plates and shipment boundary separate. Manufacturing is the reference function; mineral throughput and processed-mineral quality are not the inventory denominator.

Cone/impact crushers, grinding mills, wet washing/separation plants, mineral mixing/kneading/agglomerating/forming and foundry sand-mould machines; mobile tracked/wheeled plants, combustion drive, independent conveyors/feeders/dust collectors, general building foundations, spare-part manufacture as standalone products, customer quarry/mining operation, installation, use, maintenance, lifetime wear replacement and end-of-life. Dedicated fitted drive, guard and control included only within actual complete supply; detached extras are separate products.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Configured stationary electric jaw-crushing machine; configured dry vibrating mineral-screening machine.
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Cone/impact crushers, grinding mills, wet washing/separation plants, mineral mixing/kneading/agglomerating/forming and foundry sand-mould machines; mobile tracked/wheeled plants, combustion drive, independent conveyors/feeders/dust collectors, general building foundations, spare-part manufacture as standalone products, customer quarry/mining operation, installation, use, maintenance, lifetime wear replacement and end-of-life. Dedicated fitted drive, guard and control included only within actual complete supply; detached extras are separate products.
reviewed_boundary.market_state: Accepted new complete stationary electric machine ready for shipment; fitted replaceable wear surfaces included, spare sets and transport packing excluded from net mass.

unresolved_flow_identities.reason: Steel slabs, liquid metal, shot and cast pipe candidates do not establish a prepared crusher-frame casting.
Generic dust/waste particulate or ore candidates do not identify captured low-alloy grinding dust composition.
Returned flux-cored wire, plain steel wire and unrelated compounds do not verify solid low-alloy welding wire specification.
Direct liquid-argon product is cryogenic liquid, not compressed gas; refinement returned unrelated chemical candidates.
Broad primer/industrial-coating records do not verify the supplied epoxy formulation and component boundary.
Generic wastewater, steel-production wastewater and untreated product-flow records do not verify steel-part washing composition and treatment handoff.
Generic paint sludge or liquid waste identities do not establish this primer-specific supplied waste composition.
Processed mineral outputs and raw steel candidates do not identify a finished crusher frame.
Wind turbine shaft/drive identities do not establish a finished crusher eccentric shaft.
Returned processed minerals and raw inputs do not identify the finished pitman body.
Manganese ore, ferroalloy and liquid silico-manganese steel do not identify finished cast wear plates.
Crushed mineral outputs and abrasives do not identify a finished steel toggle plate.
Cast-iron stock and wind-turbine pitch components do not establish finished crusher flywheel state.
Motor/rotor/refrigeration compressor candidates do not verify a complete screen exciter.
Direct candidates are CN-unspecified type or conveyor/washing expert-estimate modules; no compatible unrestricted three-phase motor identity verified.
Returned broad candidates do not verify the specified finished steel compression spring.
Raw steel/blank or unrelated boiler identities do not establish a finished drive guard.

unresolved_flow_identities.selected_flow: Finished steel motor-control cabinet with electronics
unresolved_flow_identities.reason: Direct steel control-cabinet record has Energy reference property, not Mass, and CN scope; rejected for the kg component row.
Hydraulic/refrigeration broad components do not verify a complete jaw-setting unit.
Hydroxide, wax/oil/elementary lubricant candidates do not verify the supplied lithium-soap grease formulation.
Direct limestone candidate is for mill feed after primary crushing; target unspecified factory-test preparation/use does not establish that route.
Returned limestone product identities are not discarded acceptance-test residue waste.

evidence_limitations: Manufacturer architecture evidence: Metso April2024 and Sandvik2025 historical editions, plus Metso CVB webpage updated Aug2026; model-specific conditions only, not current universal component recipes or tests.
No per-machine mass, service life, capacity, manufacturing consumption, emission factor or loss range adopted from brochures. Actual future foreground measurement/collection is required.
Narrower stationary electric jaw crusher and dry vibrating screen scope; no complete cradle-to-gate claim or accepted classification mapping. Scientific methodology review pending.
